You will support the Process Owner in building a sustainable training platform while acting as a bridge between technical experts and frontline engineers. You are offered: Award-winning onboarding: Your manager is dedicated to providing a top-tier, structured onboarding experience (modeled after a previously award-winning framework) to ensure you feel supported and confident from day one. A unique learning ground for tech and AI: You will work alongside a dynamic, forward-thinking global team and three young, enthusiastic managers who are highly focused on digitalization and cutting-edge AI tools. Work tasks Your responsibilities will be varied and structured around seasonal priorities, giving you a chance to focus deeply on specific operational streams: - Schedule training cycles and manage the global program calendar across multiple regions. - Maintain the Learning Portal on SharePoint by updating resources and organizing new sections. - Manage participant registration and audit certification data within Workday. - Collaborate with experts to develop structured, production-ready e-learning content. - Prepare status updates and progress dashboards to track initiative success. - Support the rollout of pilot training sessions and document participant feedback. We are looking for - A Bachelors or Masters degree in a relevant field (e.g., HR, Business, Communications, or Engineering/Technology). - 2 - 6 years of professional experience within L&D operations, learning coordination, or HR operations, and interest to continue working with operative responsibilities. - Experience or strong comfort with Learning Management Systems (e.g. Workday); along with a proactive, self-taught mindset to navigate structured data systems. - Proficiency or active familiarity with modern AI tools for content creation, communication, and digital workflows. - Strong data capability: comfortable auditing, cleaning, and reporting on data spreadsheets and dashboards. - Full professional fluency in English (written and spoken). Additional advantages: - Background in technical or engineering environments - Studies in Human Resource Management or Pedagogy - Specific experience with Workday To succeed in the role, your personal skills are: - Change oriented - Supportive - Orderly - Energetic You will work in a hybrid setup from the Espoo office, where the team meets on-site three days a week. This is a fixed-term contract until December 2026, with an extension likely possible. Our recruitment process This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work. Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process. paragraphs: I am writing to apply for the Learning & Development Specialist position at Academic Work Finland Oy. My background in legal research and contract management, combined with my experience coordinating large-scale events and managing digital services, aligns perfectly with your requirements.

My work as an intern at International House Oulu has honed my event planning skills, while my role as a Legal Associate at Poise Legal India has provided me with extensive experience in drafting and negotiating commercial agreements. My recent language internship at Asianajajatoimisto Regelin Oy further enhanced my Finnish legal vocabulary and understanding of local procedures.

I am currently pursuing Finnish supplementary law studies at the University of Lapland, which demonstrates my commitment to integrating my international expertise into the Finnish legal system. I have a strong command over both English and Finnish, and I approach tasks with meticulous attention and a proactive attitude.

Academic Work Finland Oy's focus on developing talent and creating engaging learning experiences resonates strongly with my career aspirations. I am excited about the prospect of contributing to your team and helping shape the future of learning within your organization.
I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to Academic Work Finland Oy's Learning & Development initiatives.
